images.name: 영등 바람제
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original gameplay screenshot concept for a Korean fantasy game-design blog, titled in accompanying article "영등 바람제".
Primary request: An opaque widescreen 16:9 screenshot of a PURE STAGE RHYTHM GAME, crisp detailed 2D pixel art with visible square pixels, cozy traditional Korean fantasy village festival, polished actual game UI composition.
Scene and subjects: Upper half is a side-view performance stage beside a Korean seaside village at evening sunset, blue sea and small boats behind wooden festival boards. Colorful hanging paper streamers. A masked Korean folk dancer dances at center, one janggu musician and one buk drummer on the sides. Small friendly villagers in hanbok and one friendly cloaked turquoise wind spirit watch near a small ceremonial folded paper boat. Cheerful neighborly fiction, no combat.
Gameplay composition: Lower half consists of EXACTLY FOUR large vertical rhythm note lanes centered across the full width. Four highly legible lanes in blue, amber, rose, teal, with distinct note shapes as well as colors. Circle taps and several short hold notes descend toward a single bright horizontal judgement line close to the bottom. At the base label the four keys, left to right, exactly "D" "F" "J" "K". Notes clearly align in their own lane. Small gold response phrase indicator above lanes reading "RESPONSE", a small combo reading "COMBO 28", small accuracy reading "96.4%". Upper half gameplay remains large enough to appreciate musicians and dancing. Balanced usable rhythm game HUD, minimal lettering.
Style: Orthographic side-view sprites, lovingly crafted 16-bit pixel environment, sharply stepped pixel edges, limited harmonious jewel palette, no smoothing, no vector appearance, no 3D, no painted rendering.
Constraints: Original imaginary festival, do not copy or imply an authentic traditional ceremonial musical score. Stage rhythm game based on a fixed song and call-and-response. No overworld map, no dungeon exploration, no fighting, no HP bars, no card UI, no giant title, no poster composition, no extra panels, no dense unreadable text, no watermark. All elements inside frame. Landscape 1536x864 desired.

observed: 해변 축제 무대에 탈춤, 장구와 북 연주자, 마을 관객, 바람 정령, 종이배가 함께 보인다.
하단에 파랑/황금/분홍/청록 네 개 레인과 서로 다른 노트 도형이 있으며 키 D/F/J/K가 정확히 표시된다.
탭 노트, 짧은 홀드 노트, 공통 판정선, RESPONSE, COMBO 28, 96.4%가 명확하다.
전투 체력바, 카드, 던전/지도 탐색 UI가 없다.
limitations: 실제 작동 게임 화면이 아닌 AI 생성 게임플레이 컨셉 아트이다.
창작 축제 장면이며 실제 의례나 전통 악보의 재현을 주장하지 않는다.

images.name: 큰산 탈것 경주
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Original gameplay screenshot concept for a Korean fantasy game-design blog, article concept "큰산 탈것 경주".
Primary request: An opaque landscape 16:9 1536x864 widescreen gameplay screenshot of a TOP-DOWN MOUNT RACING game in Korean mountain fantasy. Clearly crisp 2D pixel art sprites and terrain, strict overhead orthographic camera, readable game action.
Scene: A winding mountain circuit, the visible section a very clear broad hairpin road with pale compacted earth, mountain pines, mossy rocks, Korean stone trail markers and a waterfall beside the bend. At least 60 percent of image is the race road itself, legible hairpin shape.
Three racing mounts, each with one small hanbok-clad rider: a selected friendly large BLUE OX entering the hairpin in the lower center; a large TORTOISE with dark green shell slightly ahead near upper left; an elegant pale DRAGON HORSE with flowing aqua mane exiting the bend near upper right. They have distinct silhouettes. All are small clear top-down sprite characters, fully on the race road, no giant illustration characters. They are racing clockwise around the bend.
Gameplay communication: a clean CYAN projected ideal racing line curves along the INSIDE road edge around the hairpin, starting under the selected blue ox and extending toward the bend exit; do not send the racing line through trees or water. Small dark skid marks behind the ox show braking before the corner. A faint translucent rival ghost trajectory follows the OUTSIDE of the same corner. Visible tactical distinction of braking/racing line versus stamina boost after corner exit.
HUD: compact top-left label exactly "LAP 2/3" and "2nd". Compact top-right minimap shows a closed circuit and three small colored racer dots. At bottom, a clearly golden stamina bar filled about sixty percent labelled "STAMINA 60%"; small speed readout "48"; one boost cooldown icon with a little "3s". HUD frames are small unobtrusive wood and bronze pixel panels. No other long text.
Style: Authentic richly detailed 16-bit game screenshot, sharply stepped square pixels, orthographic OVERHEAD sprite camera, lush friendly Korean mountain fantasy environment, cheerful daylight, jade greens and turquoise waterfall, clear visual hierarchy. The road and racers must look like usable 2D game terrain and sprites.
Constraints: Top-down racing with braking, line choice and stamina management. No weapons, no fighting, no HP bars, no card UI, no pickups shaped like combat weapons, no 3D rendering, no cinematic low-angle camera, no isometric render, no poster, no giant title, no watermark, no dense lettering. All HUD inside frame.

observed: 높은 시점의 2D 픽셀 게임 화면에 산길 헤어핀과 소나무, 폭포가 배치되어 있다.
파란 소와 탑승자, 큰 거북과 탑승자, 갈기 날리는 용마와 탑승자가 서로 다른 실루엣으로 나타난다.
선택된 파란 소가 커브 진입부에 있고 청록색 안쪽 주행선과 옅은 바깥쪽 경로, 뒤쪽 제동 흔적이 보인다.
LAP 2/3, 2nd, 미니맵, STAMINA 60%, 속도 48, 가속 재사용 3s HUD가 표시된다.
무기, 전투 카드, 전투 체력바가 없다.
limitations: 실제 작동 게임 화면이 아닌 AI 생성 게임플레이 컨셉 아트이다.
카메라는 수직으로 완전히 내려다보는 시점보다 경사가 있는 높은 탑다운 시점이며 캐릭터 측면 일부가 보인다.
미니맵 점과 순위는 화면 구성 예시이며 실제 경기 상태 계산을 검증한 내용이 아니다.
